name: (Cryptid, Mutant) Explosive End
text: The mutant cryptid's death reveals one last surprise as it explodes into flame, acid, a pile of toxic goop, or something stranger still. Choose a damage type appropriate for the mutant cryptid. When it dies, it explodes, dealing 1d6 untyped damage of the chosen type to each creature in a 10-foot emanation, with a basic Reflex save against a standard DC of the creature's level. The damage increases by 1d6 at 3rd level and every odd level thereafter.
